description: The US housing market, nationally or for a metro area: Zillow's typical home value with its change on a month, a year and five years and its distance from the peak; Realtor.com's listings (median listing price, active and new listings, days on market, the share with a price cut, pending sales), each against a year earlier; and the 30-year mortgage rate. rank lists the largest metros by how fast home values rise or fall. A plain summary first. No key.

area.description: "US" (default) or a metro area by its main city ("Austin", "Austin, TX", "New York").

metros.description: rank: how many of the largest metros are ranked; default 100.

rank.description: Instead of one area: the largest metros ranked by the change in home values on a year.

name: housing_market

outputSchema.description: For an area, home_value (Zillow), listings (Realtor.com, latest month) and the mortgage rate; with rank, rows are metros in the order of columns, ranked by the change in home value on a year.

title: US housing market (Zillow, Realtor.com)
